name: Cheltenham Schools and Township Open Forum

description.text:
This an open forum (without an intrusive moderator) for the discussion of anything related to Cheltenham Schools or the Cheltenham Township community.

This forum is not the official or sanctioned group for and/or of The Cheltenham Township School District or The Township of Cheltenham. 

The forum's name merely describes the intended topics for the group: the township, its schools, and the community of people within each who can use the forum to openly discuss whatever they wish.  

Without the name "Cheltenham" in the title, people who live here may not find this page and an open place to express themselves about our schools, our township, our community, or anything affected by or related thereto.

However, this does not mean "anything goes." Physical threats  and/or physical intimidation, direct or indirect, will not be tolerated. Also, this is not a place for people who have nothing of substance to add to the discussions herein and whose comments or posts merely make a mockery of the open nature of the forum such that they serve to thwart the forum's intent to be a viable and vibrant place for community discussion. Those people, their posts, and their comments will be removed.
